purpose: Execute deterministic pack-owned validation only for packs already resolved by governed discovery, bind evidence to the exact candidate head, and return bounded per-pack PASS/FAIL without becoming a transversal orchestrator.

discovery_result_requirements: status is PASS or SKIP; FAIL blocks execution
base_sha and head_sha exactly match executor inputs
each pack identity is a unique direct child of a target_root declared by the discovery contract and authorized by PACK_VALIDATION_DEFINE_CONTRACT

fail_closed_conditions: upstream discovery failed or has inconsistent status
discovery base/head does not equal executor base/head
repository HEAD is not the declared exact head
base commit is unavailable or not an ancestor of head
unknown pack type or unauthorized pack root
pack root is missing, symlinked, or escapes repository
local validator is missing, symlinked, or escapes pack boundary
local validator times out or exits non-zero
ownership_invariants: The executor consumes discovery output and must not recompute CI RUN/SKIP applicability.
The executor validates pack execution boundaries but delegates pack-specific structure, manifest and schema semantics to the pack-local validator.
A pack-local validator may validate only its pack-owned deterministic contract; cross-pack or transversal responsibilities are not legitimized by this executor and are cleaned in later owner PRs.
No PASS grants merge, runtime, database, deployment, production or semantic-quality authorization.
